newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Zalakeramia buys stake in Croatia's Inker.
newsitem.headline: Zalakeramia buys stake in Croatia's Inker.

text.p: Hungarian tile manufacturer Zalakeramia Rt acquired a 79.3 percent stake in Croatia's Inker Industria Keramike I. Porucalana D.D. (Inker) ceramics factory, Zalakeramia said in a statement on Monday.
Zalakeramia signed the deal on February 28, it said, adding that the deal was made via its Austrian subsidiary. The company gave no financial details.
Inker is Croatia's leading ceramics group, the statement said, adding that "Inker's outdated production line will be replaced by modern equipment as a result of substantial investments".
The investments are expected to double Inker's production capacity.

Inker and Zalakeramia will enter talks under which Inker would sell Zalakeramia's products during the two-year reconstruction, resulting in an 80 percent increase in the Hungarian company's exports, it said.
In 1996 Zalakeramia generated sales revenues of 3.83 billion forints of which exports accounted for 620.1 million forints. The company posted a net profit of 968.7 million.
